verdict.rationale: Org-wide admin policy enforcement is a fair question for a 2FA app that advertises team code sharing, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows per-user features: a user-configured lock screen with PIN/password/FaceID, user-set backup passwords, and temporary share links. There is no admin console, org policy engine, or any way to enforce app lock, restrict export, or mandate credential strength across members' apps.
